title: Hard-core Bosons in Action: Applications to Quantum Circuits
summary: The use of algebraic frameworks based on complex Clifford algebras for the representation and simulation of quantum circuits has been discussed in the literature. Recently, an alternative algebraic approach employing hard-core bosons has been proposed. Hard-core bosons provide a natural representation of multi-qubit systems, in which the tensor-product structure is realized directly and no sign corrections are required, in contrast to realizations based on complex Clifford algebras.
